_doc: build 29 Forge characters: THE one place that says which finished model each playable Forge character is built from. To drop in a newer model (the Phase A3 heads, or any later Forge pass), point its "source" at the new .blend (exported by export_char.py) or at a folder holding lod0.glb and lod1.glb, then run tools/forge_chars/install.sh <key> on the farm and re-export the pck. "playable" false = its rig did not pass add_hero.sh's clip gate: kept here with the reason, never installed, never pickable (fight.gd FORGE_CAST and features/waleui/characters.ts list the playable ones).

forge_courier.name: Courier
forge_courier.head_pass: A3 (18 Nov: generated head texture + landmark-aligned face; no blue nose streak). A2 was ~/forge-artist/bakeoff2/phaseA2/chars/courier/var_lens20/final.blend

forge_bram.name: Bram
forge_bram.a3: ~/forge-artist/bakeoff2/phaseA2/chars/bram/a3/final_final.blend (better head; same rig tears, 1.6 % idle / 3.4 % jog, so still not playable)
forge_bram.previous_why: add_hero.sh gate: rig tears in every clip (idle 1.6 %, jog 3.6 %, worst 7.5 % of triangles past 2.5x; gate 0.5 %), mostly the outfit at the armpits, the belt pouches beside the hands and the crotch
forge_bram.head_pass: A3 head; garment weights redone (reweight.py, Forge commit a435006): hands rigid, contact relabelled, A-pose 35 deg baked
forge_bram.known_flaws: build 30 hole check: small see-through gaps at the right armpit and through the belt pouches in overhead swings, thin fins at the glove edges, a few loose specks above the head; visible only up close, not at the game camera

forge_mei.name: Mei
forge_mei.a3: A3 not used for Mei (RESULT-A3: not better at gameplay distance)
forge_mei.previous_why: add_hero.sh gate: rig tears (idle 1.2 %, jog 1.9 %; gate 0.5 %), mostly the hakama between the legs
forge_mei.head_pass: A2 head (A3 not better for her); garment weights redone (reweight.py, a435006)
forge_mei.why: build 30 hole check (19 Nov): passes the stretch gate (65 clips) but her hands shred into shards in every swing (close turntable and the fight intro); the stretch gate does not catch it. Left out.

forge_catboy.name: Cat-Boy
forge_catboy.a3: ~/forge-artist/game/app/game3d/forge_candidates/a3/catboy_lod0_a3.glb (helmet kept, template head removed; same rig tears, 0.9 % idle / 1.9 % jog)
forge_catboy.previous_why: add_hero.sh gate: no clip under the gate for idle and hit (worst 3.4 % of triangles past 2.5x), the lifted boots and the outfit
forge_catboy.head_pass: A2 body lift, helmet head; garment weights redone (reweight.py, a435006)
forge_catboy.why: build 30 hole check (19 Nov): passes the stretch gate (54 clips) but when an arm lifts, the jacket back stretches out to the arm as a flat purple sheet (a web, like a wing) and the scarf ends fray into loose strips. Left out.
